--- create_search_index_partition_by_interleave_column.sql
-- a key column named Interleave before the INTERLEAVE IN clause
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex
ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens)
PARTITION BY SingerId, Interleave, INTERLEAVE IN Singers
--- AST
&ast.CreateSearchIndex{
  Create: 65,
  Name:   &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 85,
        NameEnd: 96,
        Name:    "AlbumsIndex",
      },
    },
  },
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 100,
        NameEnd: 106,
        Name:    "Albums",
      },
    },
  },
  TokenListPart: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 107,
      NameEnd: 124,
      Name:    "AlbumTitle_Tokens",
    },
  },
  Rparen:           124,
  PartitionColumns: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 139,
      NameEnd: 147,
      Name:    "SingerId",
    },
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 149,
      NameEnd: 159,
      Name:    "Interleave",
    },
  },
  Interleave: &ast.InterleaveIn{
    Comma:     159,
    TableName: &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 175,
      NameEnd: 182,
      Name:    "Singers",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens) PARTITION BY SingerId, Interleave, INTERLEAVE IN Singers
